note: Window: 8 fiscal quarters Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27 (calls 25 Oct 2024 - 11 Aug 2026); rule 7 added three originating entries (19 Dec 2024 business-update call; Q3 FY24 and Q2 FY24 calls), so weights run 11 -> 1. Score = sum(grade x weight) 47.8 / (2 x 39) x 10 = 6.1. Quotes are excerpts extracted from the opened transcript PDFs via text extraction (page numbers approximate +/-1); Q4 FY26 quotes come from a third-party transcription of the company audio [unverified]. Rule 6: no SEBI Reg. 30 statutory impact statement entered a call-based capture; rule not engaged. Not captured: per-tonne cost-saving claims (pipeline INR500-800/t, MDO INR150-500/t) - no filed outcome possible; undated targets (INR40,000 cr top line, ~40% margin, 10 MTPA pellet debottleneck 'No guidance'); refusals on items never guided. Pattern: physical projects (pellet plants 1-2, pipeline, DRI) delivered within the ORIGINAL dates while repeatedly missing pulled-forward restatements; approvals (EC), BHQ and volume/financing statements slipped; the zero-debt stance was abandoned and the FY26 consolidated net-debt ceiling was breached ~2.6x.
